title: Spire Bot - AI that plays the Ironclad to the Heart (A20) / 杀戮尖塔 AI
description:
[h1]Spire Bot: an AI that plays Slay the Spire by itself[/h1]
Subscribe, tick the mods, and sit back: from the main menu the bot starts an Ironclad run on Ascension 20 and plays it to the end by itself, going for the Heart. You get to watch it sweat.
订阅、勾上模组，然后看着就行：它会从主菜单自己开一局铁甲战士（进阶 20），一路打到底，目标是心脏。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13212583780956657383/EA468907B70CCE6B782C0475B9EC1C73A76509BF/[/img]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11147686180380533913/188B192B15B8B6BC4C7624E9B9B4463B7F03767C/[/img]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/12501973502685824691/9765159A0D4D26D2F4A8C5EE46F9BA942CDB0E03/[/img]
[i]A whole Act 1 boss fight (Slime Boss, A20) in three parts, nobody touching the keyboard. Sped up 2.5×.
一整场第一幕 Boss 战（史莱姆老大，进阶 20），分三段，全程没人碰键盘，2.5 倍速。[/i]

[h2]What's in the corner? / 角落里的面板[/h2]
While it plays, the bot thinks out loud in a small panel: the moves it likes best, how sure it is, and how it feels about the run.
它边打边在右上角的小面板里“自言自语”：最想走的几步、有多大把握、觉得这局打得怎么样。
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9897034255196811005/128AC5AC283129989DEA289DE8EAFB038C4AA542/[/img]
[list]
[*]Its five favourite moves, each with its share; the gold one is the move it plays. / 最想走的五步和各自的份额，金色那条是真要走的。
[*]Very sure (90%+), Fairly sure (60%+) or Unsure. / 很有把握（90% 以上）、比较有把握（60% 以上）或拿不准。
[*]AI's own estimate: its gut feeling about the whole run over the last 20 decisions. / “AI 自己的估计”：最近 20 步里它对整局的感觉。
[*]F9 pauses and resumes, F8 hides the panel, F7 switches to a plainer view. / F9 暂停和继续，F8 隐藏面板，F7 换成简单视图。
[/list]

[h2]How well does it play? / 打得怎么样[/h2]
Ascension 20 is the hardest difficulty and the Heart is the true final boss. In the real game the bot killed the Heart in [b]65 of 220 first plays (29.5%)[/b], or [b]65 of the 215 runs that finished (30.2%)[/b]. Measured on a Mac with a game-speed mod, with an earlier build and the same model, before it learned to think ahead in fights.
进阶 20 是最高难度，心脏是真正的最终 Boss。真游戏里，220 局首次开局赢心脏 [b]65 局（29.5%）[/b]；只算打完的 215 局是 [b]65 局（30.2%）[/b]。条件：Mac、开了游戏加速模组、早一版的包、同一个模型、战斗里还没有推演。
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10889029698740764249/ED6954BA98F845B756F3F0E41C7599981F683A0D/[/img]
Where does it lose? Mostly to bosses and elites, and most of all to the Heart itself.
输在哪？大多输给 Boss 和精英，输得最多的就是心脏。
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15340057122117212250/049D67582B17A88E7CBBE99309E601AC61C5E369/[/img]

[h2]How it works / 怎么工作[/h2]
[list]
[*]Communication Mod passes the game state to the bot and its commands back to the game. / Communication Mod 把游戏状态交给机器人，再把它的指令交回游戏。
[*]The bot follows the run in its own simulator, so it knows every legal move; a neural network scores each one and the bot plays the best. / 机器人用自带的模拟器跟着这局走，知道每一步能怎么走；神经网络给每一步打分，它挑最好的。
[*]Thinking ahead in elite and boss fights is off by default: the network alone, as in the results above. For stronger play, set search = "1" in spire-bot.toml (copy it from the item's spire-bot folder to ModTheSpire's spirebot settings folder first, see the README there): when unsure, it then tries its best few moves on copies of the fight, with the unknown cards drawn again (it never peeks at the real ones). / 精英和 Boss 战的推演默认关着，只靠网络，跟上面的成绩一样。想更强，把 spire-bot.toml 里的 search 改成 "1"（先从条目的 spire-bot 文件夹拷到 ModTheSpire 设置里的 spirebot 文件夹，见那里的 README）：拿不准时，它先在这场仗的几份拷贝上试几种最好的打法，没摸到的牌重新随机（不偷看真牌）。
[*]It only sees what a player sees. Its logs stay on your computer; nothing is sent anywhere. / 它只看玩家看得到的东西。日志只存在你自己的电脑上，不往任何地方发。
[/list]

[h2]Install / 怎么装[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Subscribe to Spire Bot, [b]ModTheSpire[/b], [b]BaseMod[/b] and [b]Communication Mod[/b]. Nothing to download or unzip: the bot's own Python, simulator and model come with this item (Windows and Mac). / 订阅 Spire Bot、[b]ModTheSpire[/b]、[b]BaseMod[/b] 和 [b]Communication Mod[/b]。不用下载、不用解压：机器人的 Python、模拟器和模型都在这个条目里（Windows 和 Mac 都有）。
[*]Start the game from Steam, choose [b]Play With Mods[/b], tick BaseMod, Communication Mod and Spire Bot (Steam does not tick them for you), press Play. / 从 Steam 启动游戏，选 [b]Play With Mods[/b]，勾上 BaseMod、Communication Mod 和 Spire Bot（Steam 不会替你勾），点 Play。
[*]At the main menu the bot starts a run within a few seconds. Do not click or press keys while it plays. / 到主菜单几秒后它就自己开局。它打的时候别点鼠标、别按键。
[/olist]
[b]You need / 需要[/b]
[list]
[*]Windows 10/11 64-bit, or a Mac with Apple silicon. / Windows 10/11 64 位，或 Apple 芯片的 Mac。
[*]A profile with Act 4, all Ironclad cards and Ironclad Ascension 20 unlocked; the panel says what is missing. / 存档里第四幕、铁甲战士全部卡牌和铁甲战士进阶 20 都已解锁；缺什么面板上会说。
[*]No unfinished Ironclad run (the bot will not overwrite it). / 没有打到一半的铁甲战士存档（机器人不会覆盖它）。
[*]No other mods that change cards, relics, monsters or events: the bot only knows the base game. / 不开改卡牌、遗物、怪物或事件的模组：它只认原版游戏。
[*]Communication Mod's own "command" setting left empty, or Spire Bot does not start. / Communication Mod 自己的 command 设置留空，否则 Spire Bot 不会启动。
[*]If you installed Spire Bot from the zip before, run its uninstall first (uninstall.bat or uninstall.sh). / 以前用 zip 装过的，先运行它的卸载（uninstall.bat 或 uninstall.sh）。
[/list]
[b]Good to know / 要知道的[/b]
[list]
[*]One run per game start: when the run ends the bot stops; restart the game for another. / 每次启动游戏打一局，打完就停，再看一局要重开游戏。
[*]Achievements do not unlock with mods on, and the bot's runs count in your run history and statistics. / 开了模组成就不会解锁；机器人打的局会记进你的历史和统计。
[/list]

Not affiliated with Mega Crit. Contains no game files. / 与 Mega Crit 无关，不含任何游戏文件。
changeNote: 默认关闭精英和 Boss 战推演，可在 spire-bot.toml 打开 / Search in elite and boss fights is now off by default; turn it on in spire-bot.toml (search = "1").
